pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all start 0 and that 2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' covers / and ?view=open with an item marked done.
test 'AC-3' checks done items marked ✓, in id order (marked 3 then 1).
test 'AC-4' checks all items in id order with ✓ only on done ones.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav for each view and for /.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__.

Test 'AC-7' covers the behaviour, but the item was edited after the go (commit 748ffb1) to add 'verified by review: checked by hand', which is not a real step, and no decision records the owner's approval of the edit. Treated as unmet.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; test 'AC-8' checks it.

findings.what: Commit 748ffb1 'Follow-up edits' changed AC-7 after the owner's go (2026-10-12), appending '— verified by review: checked by hand' mid-sentence. No decision in the spec records the owner's call or a date. 'Checked by hand' is not a followable step, so the marker is also invalid. The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', which is false.
findings.fix: Revert the AC-7 edit, since test AC-7 already proves it. If the owner wants a change, record it as a dated decision in the spec. Correct the PR's 'Changed after the go' line.

findings.what: 'Changed after the go: nothing' is false. The final commit edits AC-7 in the spec.
findings.fix: List the AC-7 edit under 'Changed after the go', or revert it.

findings.what: The edit left AC-7 garbled: the 'verified by review' text sits mid-sentence and splits the clause.

lenses.note: A spec exists with the owner's go. The late edit to AC-7 is the only departure found.
AC-1 to AC-6 and AC-8 are met. AC-7 was edited after the go with no recorded decision. Every state-table row has a test in the 'states' describe block.
test/done.test.js asserts rendered behaviour and would fail on broken code. The tests were not run here. CI runs them on every push.
The README describes the views. The spec's AC-7 text is garbled by the late edit.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn, and the SQL fragments come from a fixed table. No defect found.
The view value never reaches SQL or HTML, and titles are escaped. No planted instructions found.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet, and the PR says no browser was available; I judged no design review was needed.
No UI flow could be demonstrated here; the behaviour is covered by the Worker tests.
The claim 'Changed after the go: nothing' is contradicted by commit 748ffb1. The other claims match the diff.
